decision: D-789 / D788-07 + D788-08 + D788-09 + D788-16 -- THE MANUAL REINFORCEMENT CONDUCTOR IS RETIRED
supersedes: D-788 / R7-D787-10, which specified ONE Alpha 2842/19 28 AWG lead from TP12.1 to J5.3 with a dimensioned route, named adhesive anchors and a 25 mOhm acceptance; and D-787 / R6-A01 before it, which ran TWO conductors onto one 1.00 mm pad.
scope: first-five manual accessory-voltage reinforcement: NONE.  /ACC_3V3_SW is delivered to BOTH J5 contacts by routed board copper alone.

why_it_is_retired.summary: Round-8 raised FOUR independent findings against this one lead, and every one of them is a property of the lead rather than of how it was written down.  The lead's entire electrical value was 70 mV of published minimum on ONE of two duplicated contacts.  A first-article build whose first priority is working on the first order does not buy 70 mV with four hand processes that cannot be qualified.
why_it_is_retired.D788-07: the TP12.1 joint was impossible as written -- 2.0 +/- 0.5 mm of exposed tinned tip cannot lie inside a 1.00 mm round pad outline.  A buildable lap joint would have needed a strip length, a tin length, a trim length, an insulation setback, and a clearance to the nearest foreign copper, all dimensioned and all qualified on a representative joint.
why_it_is_retired.D788-08: the J5.3 termination was unqualified and, in ideal geometry, impossible.  J5 is a Samtec SSQ-124-02-G-S-RA whose 0.635 mm SQUARE tail has a 0.898 mm diagonal in a nominal 1.02 mm drill; the remaining gap is 0.122 mm at the tightest and a 28 AWG conductor is 0.32 mm bare.  The instruction said to insert it anyway.
why_it_is_retired.D788-09: the routed corridor started inside BATTERY_SHADOW and crossed RIB_R3 while the record itself demanded 1.0 mm of clearance to both.  Closing it needed a toleranced route, joint and adhesive envelope in the enclosure's own datum, and possibly a rib change.
why_it_is_retired.D788-16: the >=25 mOhm acceptance could not be measured.  The board's own routed U20.5 -> J5.3 copper stays in parallel with the lead, so an endpoint Kelvin reading across the finished assembly passes with an over-limit lead behind it.  Isolating it needed a coupon measurement before final connection, or a de-embedding with its own uncertainty budget.
why_it_is_retired.what_was_gained_instead: removing the conductor removes all four at the root, removes an adhesive cure from the critical path of every board, removes a wire from the off-board BOM, and removes a hand joint from a 1.00 mm pad and an occupied through-hole.  What it costs is stated below, in full, and is published.

measured_routed_copper_mohm.note: measured off the live board by audit_rail_ampacity's own graph on every contract run; demo_feature_contract F6 bounds both delivery paths so a re-route cannot grow them silently.

electrical_consequence.and_what_it_buys_back: the guarantee is quoted BOTH unconditionally and against an explicit connection contract.  Fully mated -- both duplicated +3V3 contacts and all four grounds, which is what a 24-way socket presents -- the port delivers 2.910494 V at the full published 400 mA with the 5 V rail also at its budget.  The unconditional figure covers the individual-jumper usage the Community Port also permits.
electrical_consequence.floor_it_must_clear: the tightest published minimum supply voltage among the parts the BOARD powers from /ACC_3V3_SW: U16 TCA4307DGKR, VCC 2.3 V MIN (TI ZHCSLQ0 section 6.3, archived vendor/TI/ti-tca4307-zhcslq0-DGK0008A.pdf).  Margin 505.637 mV.
electrical_consequence.these_numbers_are_derived_not_transcribe: D-794 / R13-06.  Every voltage in this block is DERIVED by demo_feature_contract F6 from the live board and the canonical power model, and F6 now REFUSES a release in which this file disagrees with its own derivation.  D-793 shipped this file carrying the D-789-era 2.849642 / 2.982890 V pair while F6 derived 2.805637 / 2.910494 V, and the exported fab notes -- which are generated FROM this file -- told an assembler the retired figures.  A hand-maintained consumer of a derived number goes stale; this one is gated.

source.note: TP12 and TP25 are RETAINED as test points on /ACC_3V3_SW, downstream of U20.  They carry no conductor in the first-five build and exist for bring-up measurement and for a future rework.  Nothing is soldered to them.

not_reinforced.why: the longest conductor on this rail, and the one the retired lead existed for.  It is qualified ALONE, on routed copper, at the published 400 mA.
routed copper alone always beat any manual lead that could be run to it.

retention.note: no adhesive is applied for accessory-voltage reinforcement in the first-five build.  DOWSIL 3145 remains frozen for the J4 battery-harness strain relief ONLY (D-782), and its process hold is stated there.

first_article: C-ACC-01 (SIZING / DIAGNOSTIC MEASUREMENTS -- NOT OPERATING MODES; D-803 / D803-06): measure the delivered /ACC_3V3_SW potential AT THE J5 MATING INTERFACE, between the +3V3 contact under test and the mated ground contacts, holding each load only for the reading.  (a) INDIVIDUAL-RAIL SIZING: /ACC_3V3_SW at its full published 400 mA with /ACC_5V_SW unloaded -- for J5.3 alone, for J5.22 alone, and for the fully mated header -- against the three published figures.  (b) SHARED-GROUND SIZING CASE: 400 mA on /ACC_3V3_SW with /ACC_5V_SW also at its published 300 mA through the same ground -- the worst case the published unconditional minimum is sized at; a DIAGNOSTIC reading only, because the full 400 mA + 300 mA pair drawn at the same time is NOT a supported operating mode.  (c) THE SUPPORTED SIMULTANEOUS PAIR: 220 mA on /ACC_3V3_SW with 170 mA on /ACC_5V_SW, the only both-rails load the published contract admits; record it against the same published minimum.  None of (a)-(c) extends the normal operating authority: both rails together are admitted only at the declared 220 mA + 170 mA pair, each rail's 400 mA / 300 mA budget is a single-rail budget, and no accessory rail is admitted while a radio transmits.
C-ACC-02: record the routed U20.5 -> J5.3 and U20.5 -> J5.22 resistances on the first assembled board and compare them with the bounds demo_feature_contract F6 prices the rail at.
rev_b: a dedicated Community-Port regulator, already deferred to REV-B by the owner decision of 2026-09-20, supersedes this question entirely: it removes the delivery drop rather than compensating for it, and it is the reason a hand-soldered conductor is not worth qualifying for five boards.
rationale: U20 TPS22950-Q1 current limiting and OFF isolation remain in series with both contacts and are unchanged.  demo_feature_contract F6 prices BOTH duplicated contacts independently over every permitted ground-contact count and both permitted load states, proves off the live netlist that J5.3 and J5.22 are on /ACC_3V3_SW, and DERIVES the published minimum from the worst of those modes.  audit_rail_ampacity independently qualifies the routed copper at the worst-case limiter current.
